images.prompt: Wide cinematic shot, low angle. A squad of four armored android soldiers in olive green tactical gear advances through a ruined surface bunker complex, the lead soldier aiming a modular rifle, teammates with varied equipment behind. A dropship gunship hovers in the background, physics debris and smoke in the air, red laser fire streaking across the scene.

Dynamic medium shot, tilted camera. An intense firefight with projectiles frozen mid-flight. A soldier ducks behind a cracked tiled wall while firing, an explosion throws broken floor tiles into the air, sparks and shockwaves, other soldiers in tactical positions in the background.

Side-view cross-section cutaway illustration of a huge armored mobile fortress warship hovering low over a rocky battlefield, drawn like a blueprint cutaway with the near hull wall removed so every deck inside is visible. Stacked decks of chunky machinery modules: a glowing reactor core room at the center, a hangar bay holding a small dropship, a barracks where soldiers in olive armor gear up, ammunition silos, heat sink radiator fins, turret mounts along the hull, airlocks, ladders and corridors linking every room. Tiny soldiers run between the rooms. Outside, enemy shells strike the hull and one rear module is burning and throwing sparks, while the fortress's own cannons fire back toward the right edge of the frame. Smoke and debris in the air. Flat side-on orthographic view, readable like a dollhouse, one clear subject filling the frame. No text, lettering, labels or signatures anywhere.

Portrait cover composition, heroic low angle. An armored soldier in olive and red combat gear holds a modular rifle in front of the hull of a mobile bunker fortress, squad silhouettes in the middle distance, a large starship above the curve of a planet behind them, depth of field on the main figure.

Establishing wide shot from high orbit. A green-skied colony world crowded with ring stations, towers and orbital platforms, starships trading fire in the foreground, a spiral galaxy in the sky and a huge tentacled space creature drifting in the far distance.
